seed_items.title: U.S. Pet Industry Reaches $158 Billion in 2025, Poised for Continued Growth in 2026
seed_items.summary: APPA's 2026 State of the Industry Report analyzes U.S. pet-industry spending, ownership trends, consumer behavior and generational shifts, including category expenditure outlooks.
seed_items.subcategory_zh: 市场研究 / 消费数据

seed_items.title: The Feeling’s Mutual: How Pet Wellness Benefits Both Pets and Their Humans
seed_items.summary: Circana data highlights pet wellness and humanization trends, including sustained double-digit growth in refrigerated and frozen pet food and rising demand for supplements and preventive-care products.
seed_items.subcategory_zh: 食品市场 / 消费趋势

seed_items.title: The Future of Pet Food 2026
seed_items.summary: Mintel examines the next five years of pet-food development, including environment-first nutrition, fresh food, personalization, playful treat formats and nutrient-dense upcycled ingredients.

seed_items.title: A Year of Innovation in Pet Food 2026
seed_items.summary: Mintel reviews pet-food innovation across regions, including high-protein claims, novel ingredients, functionality, sustainability and fortified-product launches.

seed_items.title: The World Market for Pet Care
seed_items.summary: Euromonitor's July 2026 global report examines pet-care growth, premiumisation, channel evolution, changing pet demographics and category opportunities through 2031.

seed_items.title: Top Five Trends in Pet Care
seed_items.summary: Euromonitor's September 2026 report analyzes affordability pressure, premiumisation, changing pet demographics, challenger brands and AI-enabled consumer engagement in pet care.

seed_items.title: FEDIAF Nutritional Guidelines for Complete and Complementary Pet Food for Cats and Dogs
seed_items.summary: FEDIAF's peer-reviewed nutritional guidelines summarize nutrient requirements and provide a practical reference for evaluating complete and complementary cat and dog foods in Europe.
seed_items.subcategory_zh: 营养标准 / 法规参考

seed_items.title: Animal Feed and Pet Food Research
seed_items.summary: Kansas State University's pet-food research covers processing effects on resistant starch and digestibility, microbiome health, grain ingredients, probiotics, food safety, wet pet food and shelf life.
